problem: V6.1 learned argmax occupancy is unsafe as physical authority
mechanism: freeze a new hard-evidence-constrained selective completion scope
minimum_experiment: scope and resource contract are explicit before implementation
falsification: scope permits V6.1 post-hoc repair or hidden-evaluator input

problem: CPSC contribution may overlap reliability, evidential occupancy, conformal prediction or hard projection literature
minimum_experiment: determine whether any work jointly covers hard FREE/OCC, defeasible learned prior, selective UNKNOWN, proposal bake and world-simulation false-safe evaluation
expected_result: no direct conjunction overlap; contribution boundary narrowed to physical-state compilation
falsification: one prior work implements and evaluates the full conjunction

problem: soft prior logits can violate observed FREE/OCC, contradiction and actor lifecycle constraints
mechanism: closed-form query-wise differentiable feasibility projection with explicit constraint precedence
hard_constraints: observed FREE and OCC are one-hot exact
OCC probability is zero outside lifecycle
minimum_experiment: one synthetic tensor test plus one real V6.1 evidence fixture integration
expected_result: exact constrained outputs with finite gradients on unconstrained queries
falsification: any constrained query violates its target or unconstrained gradients are non-finite

problem: CPSC needs sparse method-visible supervision without target/evaluator leakage or dense-grid imbalance
mechanism: metadata-only scene selection followed by paired method/target sweeps and stratified active queries
hard_constraints: at least ten targets per scene
selection cannot use occupancy quality or proposal outcome
method sweeps exclude dropout and target sweeps
minimum_experiment: freeze scene/target/sweep split then materialize a bounded query manifest with nonzero FREE/OCC/UNKNOWN/actor/boundary classes
expected_result: at least sixty target units with leak-free query rows suitable for P4/P5
falsification: any source identity appears in both method and target roles or a required query denominator is empty
resource: CPU and incremental disk below 2GiB for the first materialization
